title: Phobos exchange data pack

priority.description: Override files only: files apply lowest first (default 0), so a higher number has a later word. Leave it out unless you need it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.
Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

name.description: The exchange name in the world: 1 to 40 characters, without | , ; = # [ ] < > or line breaks.

commission.description: The broker commission, as a share of an order value.

minCommission.description: The least commission on an order, in credits.

impact.description: How hard an order pushes the price: impact = this x daily volatility x the square root of (shares / daily volume).

impactHalfLifeDays.description: How quickly the push fades: a half-life in game days.

maxOrderShare.description: The largest order, as a share of one company daily volume.

maxHolding.description: The most one player may hold in one company, valued at the asking price, in credits.

slowWeeks.description: How long a phase lasts, roughly: the slow half-life in game weeks; at least 1.5 times fastWeeks.

fastWeeks.description: How quickly a phase turns: the fast half-life in game weeks.

sd.description: How far phases carry the price: the standard deviation of the log price (0.15 is about 15%).

trend.description: The market-wide trend phase every company follows to its own degree.

moveShare.description: A change over one game day this large (a share of the price) is reported with its cause.

turnShare.description: A phase moving this fast (a share of the price per game week) counts as a trend when it turns.

reportCooldownDays.description: The fewest game days between two reports on one company.

opened.description: The year the exchange opened: no company lists before it (Phobos Exchange 0.3.0).

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

year.description: A year from 1879 to 2078: at most 200 years before the game begins in 2079.

month.description: The month, 1 to 12; without one a stable hash of the id picks it.

move.description: How far the price moved, as a share (0.4 is up 40 percent); at least 0.01 either way, and only by 2076. Without one the entry is lore only.

line.description: The line the company page lists, without figures; at most 200 characters, no placeholders.

history.description: The exchange history: events that moved every company, each by its followsMarket (Phobos Exchange 0.3.0).

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

name.description: The sector name shown on the panel: 1 to 40 characters, without | , ; = # [ ] < > or line breaks.

slowWeeks.description: How long a phase lasts, roughly: the slow half-life in game weeks; at least 1.5 times fastWeeks.

fastWeeks.description: How quickly a phase turns: the fast half-life in game weeks.

sd.description: How far phases carry the price: the standard deviation of the log price (0.15 is about 15%).

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

year.description: A year from 1879 to 2078: at most 200 years before the game begins in 2079.

month.description: The month, 1 to 12; without one a stable hash of the id picks it.

move.description: How far the price moved, as a share (0.4 is up 40 percent); at least 0.01 either way, and only by 2076. Without one the entry is lore only.

line.description: The line the company page lists, without figures; at most 200 characters, no placeholders.

history.description: The sector history: events that moved its companies, each by its followsSector (Phobos Exchange 0.3.0).

sectors.description: Sectors by id (lowercase words joined by dashes, at most 24 characters); companies in one sector share its phases.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

ticker.description: The trading symbol: two to five capital letters, unique.

name.description: The company name: 1 to 40 characters, without | , ; = # [ ] < > or line breaks.

profile.description: What the company does, in a wire service neutral voice; at most 400 characters, no placeholders.

price.description: The price when first listed in a save, in credits per share.

dailyVolume.description: Shares that change hands in a game day: the scale of the player price impact.

volatility.description: Day-to-day noise: the standard deviation of the log price over a game day.

volOfVol.description: How much the noise wanders between calm and stormy stretches.

noiseHalfLifeYears.description: How slowly accumulated noise fades back: a half-life in game years.

drift.description: The steady upward drift of the log price per game year (owner choice: real-world drift).

jumpSize.description: The typical size of a jump: a standard deviation of the log price.

spread.description: The gap between buying and selling prices, as a share of the price.

followsMarket.description: How closely the company follows the market phases (default 1).

followsSector.description: How closely it follows its sector phases (default 1).

slowWeeks.description: How long a phase lasts, roughly: the slow half-life in game weeks; at least 1.5 times fastWeeks.

fastWeeks.description: How quickly a phase turns: the fast half-life in game weeks.

sd.description: How far phases carry the price: the standard deviation of the log price (0.15 is about 15%).

station.description: The station registration whose cargo market the company follows, such as MTRS.

category.description: The game category of goods, such as AnyWeapons.

weight.description: How strongly the company follows it: positive when dear goods there help it, negative for an input; not 0.

limit.description: The most this driver may move the log price either way (default 0.12).

drivers.description: The game market signals the company follows.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

flag.description: The story flag that brings the news, set by a story arc or another mod.

move.description: How far the price jumps when the news breaks, as a share (0.08 is up 8 percent); at least 0.005 either way, each time it breaks.

wire.description: The wire line the player reads, in a neutral wire-service voice; at most 300 characters, no placeholders.

carry.description: How far the news carries the price on through the company trend phase, at its height a few weeks on; the same way as the move (Phobos Exchange 0.4.0).

keeps.description: The share of the jump that stays for good the first time this news breaks in a save; the rest, and every later jump, unwinds (Phobos Exchange 0.4.0).

news.description: Story news that moves the price each time its story flag is set (Phobos Exchange 0.2.0; recurring from 0.4.0).

newsFadeDays.description: The half-life, in game days, of the part of each news jump that unwinds (default 30; Phobos Exchange 0.4.0).

founded.description: The year the company was founded: its age, for the story and its page (Phobos Exchange 0.3.0).

listed.description: The year its shares first traded on the exchange, where its price history starts; defaults to founded, no earlier than founded or the exchange opening.

listingPrice.description: The share price at listing, for a company listed by 2076; its yearly growth to today, net of the history moves, stays from -0.05 to 0.25.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

year.description: A year from 1879 to 2078: at most 200 years before the game begins in 2079.

month.description: The month, 1 to 12; without one a stable hash of the id picks it.

move.description: How far the price moved, as a share (0.4 is up 40 percent); at least 0.01 either way, and only by 2076. Without one the entry is lore only.

line.description: The line the company page lists, without figures; at most 200 characters, no placeholders.

history.description: The company history (Phobos Exchange 0.3.0): a move comes on or after the listing, lore from the founding.

companies.description: Listed companies by id (lowercase words joined by dashes, at most 24 characters); the id names the company saved state.

description: Phobos Exchange pack: the exchange terms, its sectors and the listed companies, with their history before the game. Each company expected yearly return must stay at or below 0.14 (checked by the validators).
